🇨🇳🇹🇼 China has quietly deployed more than 100 warships and coast guard vessels across the Western Pacific, including two of its three aircraft carriers, in a massive military buildup around Taiwan.

Taiwanese officials reported on November 3 that the deployments were already in place, with Chinese forces operating across multiple regions and an aircraft carrier group moving through the Philippine Sea.

China's newest aircraft carrier, the Fujian, was also spotted leaving its base on Hainan Island, while Taiwan tracked 49 Chinese military aircraft sorties on November 2 alone.

But unlike previous major military exercises, Beijing has made no official announcement or even given the operation a name.

The Institute for the Study of War warns that the unusually large deployment may be intended to demonstrate China's ability to cut Taiwan off from international air and sea access.

The concern is that Beijing is rehearsing the military isolation of Taiwan, potentially laying the groundwork for a blockade without having to launch a full-scale invasion.

Source: Taiwan News / Writer: Mhedi

🇨🇳🇺🇸 China's spy agency ran an asset on the CEO of Nvidia... and the goal was America's best AI chips

A memo that reached Trump's top policymakers last spring cited intelligence that Alice Huang, a Chinese executive who got close to Jensen Huang at industry dinners and a Taipei bar in 2024, was working for the Ministry of State Security.

Her assignment: collect on the man who runs the world's most important chip company and nudge him toward pushing Washington to sell China its most advanced hardware.

Around the time they were photographed together, her company Megaspeed began a multibillion-dollar chip buying spree and built data centers in Southeast Asia that rent Nvidia computing power to Alibaba, a back door around US export bans, with a financial link to a Chinese military contractor underneath it.

Trump was briefed last year and chose not to act, and there are three readings of why.

The counterintelligence one: US agencies had her under surveillance for a year, and you don’t tip off a target you’re still listening to.

The political one: Jensen is one of Trump’s closest allies in business, Nvidia carries the stock market, and the two of them cut a deal giving Washington 25 percent of chip sales to China that a public spy scandal would have blown up.

The simplest one: the intelligence was just a memo, not a case, and the president decided one of his most powerful friends didn’t need a warning.

Source: New York Times / Writer: Daniel

🇺🇦🇷🇺 Ukrainian soldier CUTS OFF own foot before historic DRONE RESCUE

Kostiantyn Vlasenko, 49, survived 491 days on the front line, including months alone beneath a bombed-out school.

A Russian drone strike killed his comrade and injured his left foot, which later rotted away. His right leg was badly injured in a fall, and he deteriorated so severely that he amputated his right foot.

“I put it on a brick and took a knife. Tears were flowing; I had to cut it.”

Russian drones made evacuation nearly impossible. After 6 months of planning, Ukrainian forces delivered a harness and video instructions by drone.

On Oct. 4, a giant 6-rotor drone lifted him roughly 230 feet into the air and carried him 9 miles to safety. Commanders described it as the first known aerial drone rescue of a wounded soldier.

Drones are no longer just TAKING LIVES on the front lines; they're SAVING THEM, too.

Source: Reuters, WSJ, Censor / Writer: Marie https://t.co/zUjBXbYU9Z
